summary.title: Help us improve, privately
summary.body: Allow Google Analytics so we can see, in overall numbers, which pages help people most. <link>How we use it</link>

details.title: Cookie settings
details.body: Essential cookies keep the site working. Analytics are optional and stay off until you allow them. <link>Privacy Policy</link>
